## VecToMorph v0.1.0-research

Research prerelease with two DINOv2 blood-cell classifier profiles. **Arm C** provides the shared routine cell classes and source-specific heads. **Distilled Joint `20261123`** includes an expanded output for blasts, reactive lymphocytes and other CytologIA categories, with a separate “Blast possible” review flag.

### Performance scope

**Performance depends on the dataset, acquisition conditions and evaluation protocol.** High performance on Acevedo, MLL23 or another individual dataset does not establish comparable performance in another laboratory or imaging system. In our source-held-out experiments, training on multiple sources did not reliably eliminate source dependence. Transfer to each new target source therefore requires separate validation. The contributions of acquisition style, case mix and annotation differences remain unresolved.

The [generalization evidence overview](https://github.com/NotSure-dot-com/vec2morph-open/blob/main/model/GENERALIZATION_EVIDENCE.md) documents the comparisons and their limits. The [current model card](https://github.com/NotSure-dot-com/vec2morph-open/blob/main/README.md) and [class-level validation audit](https://github.com/NotSure-dot-com/vec2morph-open/blob/main/model/VALIDATION_AUDIT.md) provide the evaluated populations and class coverage.

### Downloads

- `vectomorph_arm_c_seed0.pth` — standalone model checkpoint, 86,882,533 bytes.
- [`vectomorph_distilled_joint_20261123.zip`](https://github.com/NotSure-dot-com/vec2morph-open/releases/download/v0.1.0-research/vectomorph_distilled_joint_20261123.zip) — expanded research profile, 13,448,698 bytes. The ZIP contains the delta checkpoint, inference code, instructions, source attribution and checksums. It uses `vectomorph_arm_c_seed0.pth` as its base.
- `SHA256SUMS` — checksum for the standalone checkpoint.
- `QUICKSTART.md` — the original short guide; the performance scope above is an updated limitation statement.

The automatically generated source ZIP includes the Arm C inference code and checkpoint.

### Distilled Joint quick start

Extract the Joint ZIP and download the Arm C checkpoint into that directory. With Python 3.11 or newer, install the requirements in a Python environment and run inference on a prepared single-cell crop.

```sh
python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
python predict_distilled_joint.py cell.jpg --base-checkpoint vectomorph_arm_c_seed0.pth --source crop
```

The loader checks both model files and can run offline. The ZIP's SHA-256 is `dfbf757e1204f5332e67ce02d894efe52337980abb1dfaef490fbfb4d1ffb452`.

In the archived CytologIA test set, the Joint review rule marked 3,373 of 3,734 Blast or LAM3 references and 367 other cells. The model recognized 325 of 499 reactive lymphocytes as reactive, and macro-F1 for the 23 original labels was 72.39%. These results describe the evaluated dataset and its annotations. The model is intended for research and teaching.

### Arm C quick start

1. Download the [source ZIP for this version](https://github.com/NotSure-dot-com/vec2morph-open/archive/refs/tags/v0.1.0-research.zip), extract it and open a terminal in the extracted folder.
2. With Python 3.11 or newer, create and activate an environment.

   ```sh
   python -m venv .venv
   ```

   Activate with `.\.venv\Scripts\Activate.ps1` in Windows PowerShell, `.venv\Scripts\activate.bat` in Windows Command Prompt, or `source .venv/bin/activate` on Linux/macOS.

3. Install the requirements and classify an image already centered on one cell.

   ```sh
   python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
   python scripts/predict_release.py cell.jpg --checkpoint model/vectomorph_arm_c_seed0.pth --source crop
   ```

CPU inference is the default. Once dependencies are installed, inference works offline. The standalone model download can replace the file at `model/vectomorph_arm_c_seed0.pth` in an existing checkout.

### Verify a standalone model download

Download `SHA256SUMS` into the same folder as the checkpoint. On Linux run `sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS`. On Windows run `Get-FileHash vectomorph_arm_c_seed0.pth -Algorithm SHA256` and compare with

```text
790a90ef6ab8f17da146e0122f38acd161462bcb31638903c26666754d18c4f3
```

Research and teaching use. Scores are uncalibrated, unfamiliar cells are not reliably rejected, and clinical use is unvalidated. The [Arm C model card](https://github.com/NotSure-dot-com/vec2morph-open/blob/v0.1.0-research/README.md) explains crop recipes, labels, evaluation and limits. Code and weights are offered under Apache 2.0. Dataset attribution is in [Arm C SOURCES.md](https://github.com/NotSure-dot-com/vec2morph-open/blob/v0.1.0-research/SOURCES.md) and in `SOURCES.md` inside the Joint ZIP.
